<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#compose">

  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ01 connects infrastructure to its constituent assets
    [OntoCorrection Agent | loop_rounds: 1 tool_retries: 1 | themis_test] swapped domain and range: Themis test expects compose domain Asset and range WaterDistributionInfrastructure</vaem:rationale>

    (themis_test) CQ01: compose domain Asset -> Absent; compose range WaterDistributionInfrastructure -> Absent</dc:source>

  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterDistributionInfrastructure"/>

  <!-- Axiom: range WaterDistributionInfrastructure -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#usedIn">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a sensor or actuator to the water infrastructure where it is deployed.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Used In</rdfs:label>

    (competency_question) CQ05: Which types of actuators are used in water infrastructures?
    (themis_test) CQ05: usedIn domain Actuator -> Undefined</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Sensor"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterInfrastructure"/>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Actuator"/>

<?xml version="1.0"?>

</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Sensor">

  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 asks about sensors used in infrastructures</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which types of sensors are used in water infrastructures?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterInfrastructure">

  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 and CQ05 ask about components used in water infrastructures</vaem:rationale>

    (competency_question) CQ05: Which types of actuators are used in water infrastructures?</dc:source>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Actuator">

</owl:Class>

    (competency_question) CQ09: What are the manufacturer and the model of the water meter?

    (competency_question) CQ25: Water meters can provide measurements according to different temporal settings.

    (competency_question) CQ39: What is the duration of the current tariff of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ40: What is the tariff period of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ42: What is the billing date of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ43: What is the billing date period of the water meter?

</owl:Class>

</owl:Class>

  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: A water meter is a device that measures different aspects of a water infrastructure.

    (competency_question) CQ09: What are the manufacturer and the model of the water meter?

    (competency_question) CQ39: What is the duration of the current tariff of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ40: What is the tariff period of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ42: What is the billing date of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ43: What is the billing date period of the water meter?

  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ25: Water meters can provide measurements according to different temporal settings.</dc:source>

</owl:Class>
